caption: The drawing depicts a single garment that appears to be an outer cloak or cape, shown from the back and rendered in black ink lines on a beige background. The cloak has two distinct layers: a shorter upper layer draped over a longer, floor-length lower layer. Both layers feature parallel decorative bands near their edges; these bands consist of a repeating floral or ornamental motif. Along the borders of both layers and the decorative bands, there is a fringe detail that follows the contours of the garment. The lines of the cloak extend downward in a flared manner, suggesting fullness, and there is an opening on the right side where a small, rounded end, possibly representing the end of a sleeve or a gloved hand, emerges. The overall composition of the image is simple, with the garment centered on a plain background, unaccompanied by any additional objects or figures.
title: Coat
